bot.noFarm: Your account is not attached to a farm.
bot.blocked: Your access is blocked. Please contact your administrator.
bot.groupOnly: I only work in a private chat. Please write to me directly.
bot.enroll2fa: Your role requires two-factor protection. Turn it on in the web app, then come back.
bot.noAssistant: The assistant is not open to your role. {{status}} and {{alerts}} still work.
bot.apology: Sorry, something went wrong on my side. Please try again in a moment.
bot.rateLimited: That is too many messages. Please wait about {{minutes}} min and try again.
bot.tooLong: That message is too long. Please keep it under {{limit}} characters.
bot.fileTooLarge: That file is too large. The limit is {{limit}} MB.
bot.voiceTooLong: That voice note is too long. Please keep it under {{limit}} minutes.
bot.unsupported: I can read text, voice notes, photos and PDF files.
bot.nothingHeard: I could not make anything out. Please say it again or type it.
bot.waitingApproval: Recorded. It now waits for a second person's approval.
bot.stale: This button is out of date.
bot.cardChanged: This card has changed. Please check it and confirm again.
bot.moneyHidden: This record holds money details your role cannot see.
bot.acknowledgeAsk: This record has something to check, shown above. Record it anyway?
bot.needsAnswer: This card is waiting for your answer. Please answer the question first.
bot.cardStale: Something on this card changed or closed, so it was not recorded. Change it or cancel it.
bot.chooseFarm: You work on several farms. Choose which one this chat works for, then send your message again.
bot.currentFarm: This chat now works for: {{farm}}. You can choose another below.
bot.otherFarm: This card belongs to another farm. Switch to it with {{farm}} and press again.
bot.notInBooks: This record is not in the books: it was refused or voided.
bot.pendingMore: {{count}} more are waiting. Deal with these first, or open them in the web app.
bot.moveAsk: This chat belongs to {{current}}, and the code is for {{next}}. Move this chat to {{next}}? {{current}} would stop getting messages and confirming here.
bot.moved: This chat now belongs to {{next}}. {{current}} is no longer linked here.
bot.movedAway: Your account was linked to another Telegram chat, so this chat no longer works for it. If this was not you, unlink the new chat on the Notifications page and change your password.
bot.unlinked: This chat was unlinked from your account.
bot.editIgnored: I do not read edited messages. To correct a record, press Change on its card or write a new message.
